prompts.rough: A sawyer's wooden trestle, two crossed pairs of rough legs with a beam on top, that already has the shape of a very bad horse: a tied bundle of straw as the head, two short pieces of rope as reins. Around it a low fence of wooden stakes, and a small wooden niche with a laurel sprig. Salvaged planks, straw, rope, all matte and weathered. A sculptor in a plain tunic stands a little apart, head tilted, mallet on his shoulder, looking at it. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab. Three-quarter view from above. No hanging cloth, no real horse, no glow.
prompts.grand: A low hall of cut warm ochre stone with rust-red roof tiles, short stout columns and a tall pointed-arch window with plain grey stone tracery and no coloured glass, no figures, no letters. In front of it stands a big draught horse in the making, taller than the hall: the front half is carved stone, with a broad chest, thick neck and a heavy plain head with calm ears; the back half is a rough wooden scaffold of planks like an upturned boat hull, with a broom as its tail. Its feet are huge round hooves, standing square on the ground, never rearing. Stone and oak do not quite match, on purpose. A sculptor in a plain tunic sleeps sitting against a small hay bale beside it. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab. Matte stone and wood, no gloss, no gilding, no gray smoke, no painted cast shadows. Three-quarter view from above.
prompts.mythic: A whole heavy draught horse of dark warm stone, as tall as two houses, on a low stone plinth. Stocky body, thick legs, round rump, thick mane in big chunky locks, enormous feet with broad hooves, standing calmly with all four hooves on the plinth, never rearing, a slender crack in the plinth beside the front hoof where a low small orange flame rises. No wings. On its back sits one carved stone rider, finished and handsome, upright in the stirrups, one hand on the reins and the other a closed fist at his side, not raising both arms. To the right, small and at its own size, the old wooden sawyer's trestle is set into the plinth. Behind the horse a lower stone hall with a plain arch and a small pennant. Matte stone, no gloss, no gilding, no stained glass, no letters. Only two small figures at most, a child and a sculptor, large and clear. A small feathered patch of ground around the plinth. Three-quarter view from above.

prompts.rough: A huge closed fist of very old dark weathered stone coming out of a green meadow, as tall as a man, smooth with age, four fingers and a thumb clearly readable and thick, moss on the knuckles, so that it first looks like a rock. Cheerful green grass all around, no horror, no zombie look. Beside it a tiny wooden roof on two posts with a lantern, and a laurel sprig hung over the thumb. An old woman with a shovel digs slowly beside it, large and clear. A fat grey pigeon sits on the first knuckle. Matte stone, no gloss, no gray smoke, no painted cast shadows. Three-quarter view from above.
prompts.grand: An enormous forearm of dark ancient smooth stone rising from the earth and bending at the elbow into a huge right angle, with a clear elbow. In the hollow of the bent arm sits a hall of cut warm ochre stone with stout columns, a pointed arch and two stiff banners stretched on wooden frames, no hanging cloth. Behind the arm, the top of a stone head emerges half buried in earth: forehead and brow ridges, eyes closed. Dark old rock against warm ochre new stone, two ages visible. A shallow timbered pit around it, no stone steps, no quarry. An old woman leans on her shovel in front, large and clear. Matte, no gloss, no gilding, no gray smoke, no painted cast shadows. Three-quarter view from above.
prompts.mythic: A stone colossus rising out of the ground to the waist: head, broad shoulders, chest, one arm bent at the elbow with the fist at the highest point of the picture. Dark smooth ancient rock, with earth and roots still clinging to the shoulders. No legs, nothing carried on it, human body, calm closed-eyed face without expression. In the hollow of the bent arm sits a small hall of cut warm ochre stone with a pointed arch. A tiny wooden roof on two posts rests at the foot of the thumb. On the shoulder a carved stone pigeon as big as a wheelbarrow, same old rock, with a real grey pigeon perched beside it. Small stone steps crack open in the grass around the body. An old woman stands at the foot, large and clear. Not a zombie hand, cheerful green grass, no mist, no vapor. Matte, no gloss, no gilding. Three-quarter view from above.

Figures large and clear, no hanging cloth.
